prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one transparent sprite turnaround sheet for an existing MapleStory-style 2D pixel character named Benoa. The reference image is the EXACT character identity: lime green long straight hair with side-swept bangs, blue/purple jeweled hair ornament on her right with a turquoise and purple hanging tassel, pink/red eyes, white blouse with dark suspenders and red neck ribbon, dark skirt/shorts and tall dark boots, red/dark cape and purple/gold ornament behind, holding an ornate gold circular magical weapon with an orange glowing center. Draw FOUR full-body poses of this SAME character in a SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW, four equal-width separate cells, left to right: (1) three-quarter front turned toward screen-left; (2) full left-facing side profile; (3) three-quarter back facing away toward screen-left; (4) straight rear view fully facing away, no face visible. Camera remains fixed, only the character turns in place. Preserve the hairstyle length, all clothing colors and shapes and accessories, scale of the big head and small body, pixel shading and thick dark pixel outlines. In the rear view the long green hair covers the back of the head and upper back, and the red/dark cape and purple/gold rear accessory are visible. No invented wings or hats or extra weapons. Each pose has exactly the same pixel character height and baseline, with generous transparent padding around each pose and no overlap between cells. Crisp hard square pixel art with a coarse native sprite grid around 62x76 pixels per character, enlarged with nearest-neighbor appearance. No smooth painting or antialiasing or vector look. Actual transparent background, no floor, shadows, labels, text, cell borders, checkerboard or scene. Just the four isolated matching sprites in one wide image.
